programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Atlanta Prison Riot
programme.desc: In 1987, Cuban prisoners at the Atlanta Federal Prison broke out homemade weapons and stole handcuffs and radios from prison staff. Soon, the inmates controlled most of the central buildings, taking more than 100 hostages. The FBI was forced to negotiate with hostile prisoners to end the standoff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: No Place to Hide
programme.desc: In the spring of 1997, a killer preyed on senior citizens in the quiet town of River Parish, Louisiana. Victims were robbed, beaten, shot and left for dead. FBI agents soon connected the violent crimes to an area mechanic with a gambling problem.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a series of bank robberies in Texas baffled authorities. But when similar thefts occurred the next year in California, FBI agents linked the crimes and established a modus operandi. Another year later, the robbers took hostages during a violent heist in Las Vegas and the FBI was tasked with stopping these criminals once and for all.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambushed an armored car, killing both guards and seizing thousands of dollars. Authorities were able to link the crime to a series of armed robberies on gambling houses, including the MGM Grand Hotel and Casino. Their main suspect was a recently paroled man with a history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home. Police tracked the suspects to a nearby park but the criminals were able to escape after a nearly fatal shootout. One year after the original crime, the FBI was called in when new clues emerged regarding the location of the suspects.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: This special episode examines previous cases to learn about the investigative techniques and innovations used by the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a Croatian terrorist group linked to the National Resistance party committed acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the United States. With the help of an informant, the FBI apprehended, arrested and convicted members of the group of crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a rash of home invasions plagued the Detroit area. Each time, masked men disguised as police officers broke in with assault rifles and stole money and jewelry. But when one homeowner shot back, the identity of the intruders was revealed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1985, a Lebanese terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian Flight 405 shortly before take off in Beirut. Several American citizens were on board. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force charged with bringing the terrorist mastermind to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An escapee from Castro's Cuba was the mastermind behind a secret terrorist organization called Omega 7. This group sought to carry out their mission through bombings and assassinations, financing their crimes through extortion and by assisting drug traffickers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Great Philly Mob War
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Evidence as minute as hairs and fibers can be used to track killers and victims whereabouts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: How murders can be solved even when the body is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The most famous serial killer (Ted Bundy), who may have killed 40 women, was only convicted because of an odontologist's being able to match his teeth with a bite mark on a victim in Florida.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, a maid discovered that a copy machine, placed in a busy Las Vegas casino, was actually a bomb. Agents and bomb experts were called in to disarm the deadly device and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A special task force was formed in the early 1990s to combat the flow of Colombia cocaine into New York ports. As part of an elaborate sting operation, one detective went undercover and infiltrated a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a parole officer was found shot dead in his car, the FBI, DEA and NYPD struggled to contain the mounting violence from drug gangs that continued to escalate. Authorities sought to put two ruthless drug kingpins, Howard Pappy Mason and Lorezno Fat Cat Nichols, behind bars for the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the FBI investigated wide-scale corruption among the detectives of the San Juan, Puerto Rico Police Department. Drug trafficking, extortion, kidnapping and murder-for-hire were among the department's known illicit activities. One detective, Victor Sousse, broke the blue wall of silence and went undercover to help the FBI close the lid on the corrupt cops' activities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When an 80-year-old woman is found barely conscious next to the body of her murdered son in an abandoned van, the FBI was brought in and linked the crime to a teenager and middle-aged man.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When notorious bank robber Byron Chubbuck escaped from New Mexico State Penitentiary in 2000, he almost immediately began stealing again. Though he claimed the stolen loot went to the poor, Chubbuck was no folk hero and the FBI teamed up with U.S. marshals to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On July 4, 1987, seven inmates broke out of a high-security prison in New Mexico. The daring escape was orchestrated by convicted murdered William Wayne Gilbert, who was serving a life sentence. In a dangerous manhunt and race against time, authorities and scientists used the Bureau's crime laboratory to catch these dangerous criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents tracked down a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. As the robberies grew increasingly more violent, authorities launched a complex sting to trap the deadly ring of thieves.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dartmouth Professors Susanne and Half Zantop are found brutally murdered in their quaint New Hampshire home. Colleagues confirm that the couple was very well liked. With no trace of forced entry, the FBI Behavioral Science Unit investigated the crime and found two teenagers were responsible for the heinous crime.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Harpers Ferry in West Virginia, to try to save a historic hotel thats desperately in need of help. Karan Townsend, the owner, runs the hotel like a thrift store and hoards junk everywhere. Under Karans management the business and the hotel have started to fall apart. Gordon gets the shock of his life as he witnesses the worst dinner service he has ever had the misfortune to see. This disaster of a hotel could be too much for even Gordon Ramsay to save.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon continues his mission to fix the failing Towns Inn in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia despite having to shut down the hotel after witnessing some shocking food practices. These are some of the worst Ramsay has encountered; some so serious they threaten the lives of the guests, as well as the life of the hotel. Gordon is left in even more disbelief as he uncovers some even more terrifying cleanliness issues.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: The Vienna owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach are at their breaking point and have become trapped in their Austrian themed hotel, drowning in debt. Gordon discovers some shocking rumors about the owners and the real reason customers have stopped coming to the European inspired Inn. Can Gordon keep the doors to this historic hotel open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Cambridge, New York, where ex-military man John Imhof and his wife, Tina, own and run the allegedly haunted Cambridge Hotel. General John runs the hotel like a dictatorship, an approach thats driving the staff crazy and the guests straight out the door. Gordons stay at the hotel is genuinely terrifying, but its not the ghost that keeps him awake, its something far worse.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The Keatings supercar-obsessed owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The River Rock Inn in Milford Pennsylvania, where owner Ken Pisciotta is over his head and drowning in debt. Unable to get any guests to stay in his neglected inn, Ken has all but given up, and his constant negativity is making the entire staff question whether lifes too short to continue working there. Can Gordon get the River Rock back on track before Ken loses everything?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Juniper Hill Inn in Windsor, VT, a place that looks like a million dollars but smells of raw sewage. He meets the inns wealthy and arrogant owner, Robert Dean II, and uncovers his shocking treatment of his staff. Gordon quickly realizes its going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Its Gordons greatest challenge to date, as he continues to uncover problem after problem at Vermonts Juniper Hill Inn. He tries to help the staff against arrogant owners Robert and Ari, but after catching one of them in a shocking lie, Gordon feels he has no choice but to do something hes never done before. Abandon ship.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Coeur DAlene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B. To make matters worse, John's wife Tina is ready to run away from the inn and from her buffoon of a husband. Can Gordon get through to John before he destroys both his business and his marriage?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars, an array of diamond rings and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel, and his life. Gordon discovers the extent of Phillips problem when he sees shocking news about the owner splashed all over the front page of the newspaper. Can Gordon save fifty staff jobs and keep the doors to this ninety year old hotel (a place once described as the jewel of Longview) open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegates owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his Butt Hut than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn. Richards sons Duke and Dusty are too busy fighting each other to notice the ever-increasing debt, leaving their mother, Joanna with the entire burden of the inns finances resting on her shoulders. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed? And how will he react to a room full of dancing mushrooms and a dog that swims through the air?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Starkville, Mississippi to try to rescue the failing Hotel Chester. Despite having over 40 years experience in the hotel business, owner David Mollendor is at a loss on how to make his dream of owning his own hotel work. Sukie, his wife, is struggling as the hotel restaurants chef, tackling the role without any culinary experience, and sinking fast. Gordon discovers a family tragedy which explains why this couple have become trapped in their hotel and are drowning in debt. Gordon is desperate to help the two owners escape from their suffering, but is he too late to stop the hotels doors closing for good?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits West Dover in Vermont, to try to save a dog-friendly hotel thats desperately in need of help. Sandy MacDougall, the owner, runs the hotel like a hostel with unpaid staff staying in the rooms instead of paying guests. Can Gordon get the Four Seasons back on track before Sandy loses everything? Or is the kindest thing simply to put this dog-friendly hotel to sleep?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to Murphys Historic Hotel near Sacramento in northern California, where party-boy owners Brian, Kevin and Joel are too busy drinking, partying and lap-dancing in the rowdy bar, to look after their historic hotel. The national landmark, which has been host to an array of famous names including Mark Twain, President Ulysses S. Grant and J.P. Morgan, has no hotel manager, so guests have a miserable time in the noisy, neglected, afterthought of a hotel. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this chaotic place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon checks in to Connecticuts oldest inn, the Curtis House. The inn is currently run by brother and sister, T.J and Chris, but they no longer speak to each other and the staff and guests are stuck in the middle. Can Gordon save the historic inn and rescue a family at breaking point? And what will Gordon make of Betty, the inns resident ghost who he has to share a bedroom with?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Historic Calumet Inn, in Pipestone, Minnesota. These spoilt little girls have been playing hotel for nine months, and their idle behavior has left the staff working double time, and on the brink of revolt, and their guests suffering. programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.desc: Willie (Thomas Haden Church) is a goodhearted man living rough on the dangerous streets of Los Angeles’ Skid Row and finds himself coerced by two rich teenagers into fighting other homeless men for cash. Stuck in a violent world he doesn’t fully understand, Willie finds solace when he discovers the discarded diary of a troubled young girl and befriends a homeless veteran, Pinky (Boyd Holbrook). A cab driver named Pope (Terrence Howard) lends Willie a blanket, looks after his friends on the street, and is protective of this little world normally condemned to invisibility. Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church and Terrence Howard join GONE GIRL actor Boyd Holbrook in Knate Lee’s (BAD GRANDPA, JACKASS 3D) directorial debut, a powerful tale of loss, redemption, and friendship.

programme.title: American Violet

programme.title: Half of a Yellow Sun
programme.desc: Olanna (Thandie Newton) and Kainene (Anika Noni Rose) are glamorous twins from a wealthy Nigerian family. Upon returning to a privileged city life in newly independent 1960s Nigeria after their expensive English education, the two women make very different choices. Olanna shocks her family by going to live with her lover, the “revolutionary professor” Odenigbo (Chiwetel Ejiofor) and his devoted houseboy Ugwu (John Boyega) in the dusty university town of Nsukka; Kainene turns out to be a fiercely successful businesswoman when she takes over the family interests, and surprises even herself when she falls in love with Richard (Joseph Mawle), an English writer.

UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features a middleweight kickboxing tournament with Darius Olteam versus Edmond Mustafa, Cezar Buzdugan versus Stefan Vranceanu, Andre Varga versus Cristian Neacșu and Laurenti-Gabi Fatiol versus Albert Enache. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: UFA 493 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. Tonight features two heavyweight matchups and the finals of the middleweight tournament. In the first heavyweight bout Petrisor Gananau faces Leonard Ioncila in an Entertainment Boxing Match. Next up is a kickboxing Super Fight in the heavyweight division with Tibor Varga facing undefeated Vasile Corcodel in a Hungary versus Maldova faceoff. In a boxing matchup in the Super Middleweight division, Valentin Cioaca faces Veronel Tarau. The main event is the final of the eight man pyramid tournament to determine the DFS Middleweight Champion.

programme.title: UFA 489 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 1 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. First up is a female matchup in the lightweight division between Karolina Kadzielawa and the more experienced Molly McCulloch. In the next bout with Full Thai Rules, Frank Mulley takes on Shea Patton with an undefeated record. In a welterweight feature fight of the night, "The Boy" Ryan Moore steps into the ring with Saj Imran.

programme.title: UFA 490 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 2 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. Starting off this episode, undefeated Josh Gravesande takes on AJ Durrani in a bantamweight contest. In the next bout, Harry Moore takes on the more experienced Lyes Marinko in the welterweight division. In the main event, Mo Abdurahman takes on lias Krafi for the Featherweight World Title with Full Thai rules and no elbows in this matchup between South Africa and Morocco.

programme.title: UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. Hometown favorite Anthony Dooley "The Stormin' Morman" takes on Nick Maxwell. In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: UFA 345 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London. In this episode, Sean McPike faces Ash Williams in a battle between Birmingham and Wales. Nathan Decastro takes on Tony Shields, Luke Smith gets in the ring with Corey Healey, Liam Rees fights Joe Fitzpatrick in a flyweight title clash and Bradley Scott current cruiser weight champion faces the challenger Kevin Greenwood for the title.

programme.title: UFA 346 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London part 2. Starting off this episode, Ireland's Jonny Lawson battles Brighton's Sonny Smith in the Prize Fighter semi-final bout and Aaron Sinclair and Scott McHugh matchup for the second semi-final bout where the winning fighters will head to Thailand for the final match. Dan Lerwell takes on C.J. Mills in the World Middle Weight Title clash and in the main event Jimmy Sweeney takes on Ionel Levitchi.

programme.title: UFA 378 - Shamrock FC 354
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 354 from Ameristar Casino. Up first is Garren Lucas verus Eric Carrera while Gabe Stein and Joseph Murphy face off. Kody McGehee and Ernest Bolt battle it out for the lightweight title and in the main event Darian Weeks faces Max Choriev in a match between two UFC veterans.

programme.title: UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1

programme.title: UFA 475 - Shamrock 370 part 2

programme.title: UFA 473 - Clan Wars 53 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Padraig Irvine steps into the cage with Sean Gallagher and fan favorite Christopher Boyd squares off against Maksym Danchevesky. programme.title: UFA 477 - Clan Wars 53 part 2

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3

In the co-main event Mick McBride and Shivraj Patil look to trade punches in the cage.

programme.title: UFA 486 - Clan Wars 54 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up, in a female bout, Alexa Padugan squares off against Gemma Coghill in a rematch. Next up in the welterweight division, Kyle Paton faces "Lethal" Shea Leathem and in the main event, Bobby Smith and Chris Boyd take to the cage for what's expexted to be an explosive matchup.

programme.title: UFA 488 - Fighters Only 17th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.title: UFA 489 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 1 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 2 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: UFA 493 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Bootsy Collins - Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay - Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru - Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'

Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘’S Wonderful’, the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started’ and ‘Honeysuckle Rose’. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose’ on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol’s composition ‘Perdido’ closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane - Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Jamie Cullum - Jazz à Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella - Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Bootsy Collins - Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald - O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner - Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius - Donna lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius’s electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Earl Hines - Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay - Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Jamie Cullum - Jazz à Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Johnny Cash - Live at Montreux 1994
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they’d never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.desc: Sheffield’s finest make their long-awaited debut at London’s O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let’s Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from Garden Grove, California, formed in 1984. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan "Dexter" Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin "Noodles" Wasserman.

programme.title: Motörhead - Rock Im Park
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days. Featuring : Motörhead

programme.title: The Killers - Live at Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: Sarah Brightman - Symphony in Vienna
programme.desc: Sarah Brightman is an English soprano singer who has won 160 gold and platinum albums in 34 countries. Only the soundtrack to the musical The Phantom of the Opera, played by Sarah, sold more than 40 million copies.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - American Landing : Live at Monterey
programme.desc: In June 1967, Jimi Hendrix returned to his native country and transformed the cultural, musical and fashion landscapes. Punctuated by Hendrix lighting his instrument on fire, the U.S. debut performance of the Jimi Hendrix Experience at the Monterey Pop Festival propelled the guitarist and his band mates to the top ranks of international rock royalty.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Johnny Cash - Live at Montreux 1994
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they’d never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Love in Design
programme.desc: In need of a shakeup on her home-makeover TV show, Hannah is sent to her New England hometown to renovate the historical Lewisburg Manor. Her old flame Jeff is assigned to make sure Hannah's design preserves the historical manor.

programme.title: Season for Love
programme.desc: When a talented chef returns to her Texas hometown, she winds up entering the town's famous BBQ cookoff and gets more than she bargained for when the surprise judge turns out to be her high school love. Stars Autumn Reeser.

programme.title: Love, Once and Always
programme.desc: When Lucy's childhood sweetheart plans to tear down the Gilded Age estate and replace it with a golf course, Lucy fights to preserve the historic mansion at all costs. Stars Amanda Schull and Peter Porte.

programme.title: A Valentine's Match
programme.desc: Fired from her job as a reality TV host, Natalie returns home for Valentine's Day, only to find herself running the town festival's auction with her ex-fiance thanks to two scheming mothers. Bethany Joy Lenz, Luke Macfarlane.

programme.title: Love on the Sidelines
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a down-on-her-luck young woman who falls into a job as a personal assistant to a star quarterback. He's never had a female assistant before and she knows nothing about football.

programme.title: Unleashing Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: Elizabeth gets the opportunity of showing her dog in a New York dog show. The judge, Donovan Darcy, comes across as aristocratic and rude, and a chain of misunderstandings unfold, complicating their attraction to one another.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: Elizabeth and Donovan are very different people; she's a down-to-earth high school teacher and he's a reserved New York businessman. So, when they get engaged, their trip to the altar is lively and unpredictable.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas
programme.desc: Prince Leopold, heir to the throne of Cordinia, falls in love with Emily Taylor, a humble seamstress from Philadelphia. But the young prince's wishes are challenged by his mother, who wants him to marry royalty.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts? Stars Lacey Chabert, Will Kemp.

programme.title: The Dancing Detective: A Deadly Tango
programme.desc: A no-nonsense detective must reluctantly team up with a charismatic British dance star in order to solve a murder. Stars Lacey Chabert, Will Kemp.

programme.title: Crossword Mysteries: A Puzzle to Die For
programme.desc: After several of her puzzles are linked to the murder of an art gallery owner, a crossword puzzle editor teams up with a no nonsense detective to stop a killer in their midst. Stars Lacey Chabert, Brennan Elliott.

programme.title: Crossword Mysteries: Proposing Murder
programme.desc: Tess dives into Logan's murder investigation of her friend who was about to propose with her help. As she grows closer to the truth, she fears it could ruin everyone's happily ever after. Starring Lacey Chabert, Brennan Elliott.

programme.title: His & Hers
programme.desc: Lawyers Mark and Dana are the perfect married couple until they find themselves on opposite sides of a highly public divorce case involving a warring reality show couple. Stars Lacey Chabert, Brennan Elliott.

programme.title: Love at First Dance
programme.desc: Hope is tasked with teaching Manhattan's former "Most Eligible Bachelor" how to dance for his extravagant, society wedding. But as the dance lessons progress, complications ensue when feelings begin to develop between them.

programme.title: A Harvest Wedding
programme.desc: Sarah, a wedding planner in New York, is hired to plan the most anticipated wedding of the season. But the bride wants the wedding to be on the family farm which is now being run by her older brother who happens to be Sarah's ex.

programme.desc: With a case of writer's block, a children's author escapes to small town Mitford for a change of scenery. She soon finds the heart and soul of the southern town in a priest as they work together to care for a young boy.

programme.desc: When struggling bookstore owner Mary and the bad boy of professional hockey, Adam, are teamed together to help facilitate an image makeover for the other, they soon realize that opposites attract.

programme.desc: A widowed surgeon visits her family's pear orchard in hopes of reconnecting with her distant son. She starts to fall for the farm manager, Will, who is growing a new hybrid pear, and teaches her the importance of her heritage.

programme.title: Sun, Sand & Romance
programme.desc: Kate is a driven publishing exec visiting a summer resort with her boyfriend Eric. There she runs into Shep, an old high school friend and fellow camp counselor, who is now the Activities Director.

programme.title: Junebug
programme.desc: Juniper, a book editor turning 40, is magically reconnected with an eight-year-old version of herself who questions her life choices, including the dream of writing her own stories. Stars Autumn Reeser, Aaron O'Connell.

programme.desc: Contestants on The One, Stephanie and Oliver try to determine if they're fated to be together. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Stephanie and Alex, the handsome ranch owner who acts as their guide. Stars Pascale Hutton and Sam Page.

programme.desc: Nate and Brooke are going to the same four weddings, four weekends in a row. To avoid set-ups, they go together as "wedding buddies." But what starts as a friendship soon becomes deeper. Stars Kimberley Sustad, Paul Campbell.

programme.desc: As Valentine's Day nears, a matchmaker is tasked by her mentor to find a match for an entrepreneur who believes staying single is the key to success. Stars Taylor Cole and Ryan Paevey.

programme.title: An Unexpected Valentine
programme.desc: A chance encounter on Valentine's Day brings Hannah and Finn together as they race through New York City to return a lost engagement ring and save one couple's special day. Stars Lacey Chabert, Robert Buckley.

programme.title: The Love Heist
programme.desc: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala. Stars Lyndsy Fonseca, Peter Porte.

programme.title: Lost in Paradise
programme.desc: When the founder of a high-end fashion company gets marooned on an "deserted" island with a chef, romance blossoms as they work together to survive. Starring Lacey Chabert and Ian Harding.

programme.desc: Nonprofit executive Chelsea is in Paris to secure a major donor, but begins an unexpected journey across Europe to reconnect with her past loves. Stars Lacey Chabert, Scott Michael Foster, Henry Czerny, and Barbara Niven.

programme.desc: When Georgia travels to the Greek island of Corfu to finalize an inheritance, she unexpectedly discovers that marrying her handsome co-inheritor is the only way to meet the requirements. Stars Nikki DeLoach, Apostolis Totsikas.

programme.desc: As Anna travels back to Barcelona, reuniting with Erica to celebrate her engagement to Nico, she meets a charming farmer and accidentally finds herself "engaged" to save his family's legacy. Stars Ashley Williams, Alison Sweeney.

programme.desc: Journalist Trish is on back-to-back bridesmaid duty for her three best friends. Finding herself without a date, she pairs up with photographer Ryan, the brother of her best friend. Stars Stephanie Bennett & Casey Deidrick.

programme.title: Poison in a Pear Tree - Part 2

programme.title: Roux the Day: A Gourmet Detective Mystery

programme.title: God's Bomber
programme.desc: The 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia are rocked by a massive pipe bomb explosion. A woman is killed and hundreds injured. Subsequent bombs at an abortion clinic and a gay bar show a similar M.O., and increasing refinement. Police have no clue who is behind the bombings until they receive a letter signed by ‘The Army of God’, an anti-abortion, anti-gay, white supremacist group. When another abortion clinic is bombed in Birmingham, Alabama, a witness sees a suspicious man leaving the scene and gets his license number. Police are soon on the trail of Christian extremist Eric Rudolph, but it will take a five year manhunt through the rugged terrain of the Natahala National Forest before they can catch America’s Most Wanted criminal.

programme.title: Forsaken
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. programme.title: Forsaken
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Atomic Dog
programme.desc: A self-appointed angel of death on a mission beyond the law. A sniper who targets abortion doctors and then disappears into the shadowy underground that supports and protects him. But when the sniper’s mission moves to murder, a city is thrown into blind panic that spreads across the country and beyond. Armed with the very latest in forensic technology, this is one game the cops have no intention of losing.

programme.title: Pyro
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: The Fifth Commandment
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. But when homicide detectives discover the charred remains of a prominent business man, Sin City reveals a darker side. With a long list of suspects and millions of dollars on the line, investigators are suddenly thrust into a dangerous world of high stakes deception fueled by passion, greed and revenge. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Disappeared
programme.desc: While shooting pool in a Louisiana bar, Andre Daigle meets a beautiful and mysterious woman. That night he disappears. With no clues to go on, Andre's family calls in psychic Rosemarie Kerr - whose remarkable visions provide answers to a baffling crime. In New Jersey, a teenage girl vanishes while walking home from school. Witnesses saw her walking near a young man whose alibi is shaky. But police have no evidence and must release the suspect - who then vanishes himself. Psychic Nancy Orlen Weber joins the case and offers uncannily accurate descriptions of the crime, the suspect - and where he's hiding.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Piece,' hosts Danielle and Shay dive into a lively discussion filled with personal stories and reflections. Filmed during an evening session, they explore topics such as the hosts' preference for nighttime energy, the nap debate, memorable college experiences, and the cultural differences in substance use. They also touch on the impact of natural disasters like California fires, the importance of healthy eating, and Shay's personal revelation about her dating life and the importance of shooting your shot. It's a candid conversation that offers a mix of humor, nostalgia, and genuine advice.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Nine: Fun Facts and True Friendship: How Well Do You Know Me?
programme.desc: Join Danielle and Shay in an engaging and hilarious episode of 'Pardon My Peace' as they dive into a series of personal questions in the game 'How Well Do You Know Me?'. Watch as they share fun facts about each other, discuss their pet peeves, dream jobs, favorite foods, and recall childhood memories. With lots of laughter and heartfelt moments, this episode offers an entertaining way to learn more about these two friends. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode One: The Danielle Interview
