We also discuss overcoming fears and insecurities, such as body dysmorphia, and the ways personal growth shapes our lives. Danielle shares how her son's battle with sickle cell disease strengthened her faith and relationship with God. Join us for honest conversations and a dose of authenticity.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Seven: Unpacking the Burden: Should Women Fix Men?

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and follow for more insightful discussions!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Six: Exploring Femininity: Softness, Strength, and Everything In Between
programme.desc: Join us as we dive into a candid discussion about femininity, challenging traditional notions and exploring what it truly means. This episode also addresses common misconceptions, highlights the importance of self-awareness and self-care, and offers practical advice to enhance your connection with your inner feminine energy. Whether you're looking to redefine femininity for yourself or simply curious about different perspectives, this episode is for you. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Ten: The Friendship Spectrum: From Daily Chats to Timeless Bonds
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, Danielle and Shay reflect on personal experiences, discussing the differences between high maintenance and low maintenance friendships. They share a gripping story of a near-miss scare involving Danielle's son, Declan, emphasizing the importance of staying calm in emergencies. The conversation delves into the dynamics of friendships, introversion, extroversion, and the need for self-care. Explore how knowing oneself and others can lead to more meaningful and balanced relationships. Join us for an insightful chat on thriving in both extroverted and introverted spaces without losing oneself!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Three: Marriage: Commitment, Paper, or Both?
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle interviews her close friend Shay. They discuss Shay's journey to finding faith, the significance of family, and the most important relationships in her life, particularly with her father. The episode also explores their rekindled friendship after years of separation, showcasing the power of honesty, growth, and forgiveness. Shay shares her passions, life lessons, and dreams, making this an inspirational story not just about friendship but also about self-discovery and resilience. Don't miss this authentic conversation filled with humor, love, and real talk. In this episode of Pardon My Peace, hosts Shay and Danielle dive into the thought-provoking topic of whether marriage is overrated. They explore both sides of the debate, discussing how societal views on marriage have evolved over time and the various reasons people choose to get married today. Danielle shares insights from her decade-long marriage, while Shay contemplates her own views on the institution. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Twelve: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part Two
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, we explore the inspiring story of Parker, a young boy who battled sickle cell disease and braved the challenges of a bone marrow transplant during the COVID-19 pandemic. Discover how Parker's resilience, family support, and their steadfast faith led to his miraculous recovery. This episode delves into the medical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of their experience, highlighting the critical role of testimonies and the importance of becoming an advocate for others facing similar challenges.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Episode 1: GREETINGS FROM DAZZLE LAND
programme.desc: In the first episode, Bommi's dream comes true when her book Libro comes to life and magically transports her into Dazzle Land where she meets her life-long, pop-up book friends.

programme.title: Episode 2: SNOOGLE BERRY DELIGHT
programme.desc: Picking, sorting, juicing and baking Dazzle Land's colorful Snoogleberries can be a lot of fun, if you follow the directions. It takes teamwork and an imaginative Dazzle to sort things out again.

programme.title: Episode 3: CHEARS FOR FEAR
programme.desc: In a Dazzle Land amusement park, Bommi and her friends confront different things that they fear, such as heights and darkness. All except Rumba, why?

programme.title: Episode 4: A TACO TALE
programme.desc: On Dazzle Land Beach Day, Taco borrows Remba's beautiful Snazzle Bedazzle Shell necklace. When he accidentally loses it, he doesn't immediately tell the truth, leading to difficult situations..

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Johanna Dohnal - Visionary of Feminism
programme.desc: Johanna Dohnal, icon of the Austrian women's movement and first Minister for Women's Affairs, shaped the Alpine Republic like hardly any other.

programme.title: Home Game
programme.desc: Hometowns, neighborhoods, community spirit, energy security and a lot of money are at stake here.

programme.title: Gisela
programme.desc: Authentic, haphazard and unromantic, three residents of a high-rise housing estate search for love, friendship and sexuality.

programme.title: I Knew You Were My Kind
The Smoothness of Our Teeth
programme.desc: A family visit and a broken tooth raises universal questions about identity, origins and life choices.

programme.title: Stained Skin
programme.desc: Despite the adverse working conditions, two friends persevere with the power of their imagination and their will.

programme.title: Atlas
programme.desc: A simple worker gets caught up in the maelstrom of real estate sharks, evictions and clan crime, where humanity often gives way to greed.

programme.title: Kick It Like a Girl
programme.desc: The Team - Harmony and team spirit are very important to the SGS girls' team. But the four protagonists have also experienced discrimination and even violence.

programme.title: Holy Island
programme.desc: Rosa and David, two lost souls, try to escape purgatory. But only one of them can be saved in the end.

programme.title: Focus on Infinity
programme.desc: A visit to the breathtaking places and the people who unlock the secrets of the universe.

programme.title: FtWTF - Female to What The ...
programme.desc: Six people talk about the absurd, the sad and above all the beautiful aspects of transitioning.

programme.title: Der Konzertdealer
programme.desc: An unusual portrait film about ex-punk Scumeck Sabottka, who has been a trailblazing tour and concert promoter for 30 years.

programme.title: Floating!
programme.desc: A lesbian bachelorette’s night out with "the guys", including, alas, her future sperm donor. A mumblecore comedy on a raft.

programme.title: Relatively Independent
programme.desc: There are only 50 metres between the Fröbel School and the Model School - but the pupils are separated by worlds.

programme.title: Kommen und Gehen
programme.desc: This film accompanies the last days of the traditional Hotel Maritim in Halle before it becomes a refugee accommodation.

programme.title: Walking on a Thin Line
programme.desc: Ibo is 26. What bothers him most is simple: its time. Dropped out of school, unsettled lifestyle. Now it's time to change before it's all too late.

programme.title: Marzenka
programme.desc: When Mareks cousin comes to live with him and his family, his life is uprooted.

programme.title: Paradies! Paradies!
programme.desc: Kurdwin Ayub, a member of the European Film Academy, tries to find out why his father falls into euphoria at the very mention of Kurdistan.

programme.title: Hashtag: School Trip
programme.desc: A school class visits the Auschwitz concentration camp in Poland. Buckle up in the bus, go to the toilet, a birthday song for Anja.

programme.title: Music
programme.desc: A conscientious civil servant dreams of a career as a musician.

programme.title: Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Kickboxing is 23-year-old Ahmet's life but as personal problems mount he loses control and commits a violent felony at a disco.

programme.title: Unmensch
programme.desc: Three young actors are rehearsing a play called 'Youth is Shit' at the Vienna Theater Experiment. The situation quickly becomes explosive.

programme.title: Pietas
programme.desc: The story focus is a young woman who opposes the strict religious doctrine of her small home village of the 1920s.

programme.title: We Are Me
programme.desc: This fakedocumentary tells of Jasper's search for truthfulness, which is doomed to failure when he turns from observer to participant.

programme.title: Nirwana
programme.desc: Simon Dolensky's graduation film from the International Film School Cologne was nominated for the First Steps Award.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: Lukasz (24) works for a big name in the industry. But after the death of his mother, his little brother Kamil (13) suddenly appears on his doorstep.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: During WWI the war reaches a small village and changes the fate of an older woman and her 12 year old friend.

programme.title: One Ticket Please
programme.desc: A monument for one of New Yorks most singular theater enthusiast.

programme.title: In The Future They Ate From The Finest Porcelain
programme.desc: In a temporal twist, this movie tells the story of an intervention into the future perception of a territory’s political history.

programme.title: Solomon's Stone
programme.desc: Black-comedy short SOLOMON'S STONE, directed by Ramzi Maqdisi, is adapted from the novel Blue Light by Hussein Barghouty.

programme.title: Clumsy Little Acts of Tenderness
programme.desc: The Finnish short comedy by Miia Tervo portrays an anything but typical relationship between a loving father and his skeptical daughter.

programme.title: Grimm’s Cuckoo
programme.desc: This short film dares a slightly different view of life in a psychiatric clinic. Screened at Cannes Short Film Corner and Interfilm Berlin.

programme.title: Oh Yeah, She Performs
programme.desc: A doc about four extraordinary women pursuing the same dream: composing, producing and living from their own music, without compromising their ideals

programme.title: Solo - Out of a Dream
programme.desc: Dutch director Jos de Putter once again follows 31-year-old soccer star Leonardo Santiago in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: Kick Out Your Boss
programme.desc: Many people want to break out of the hamster wheel of capitalism. This documentary visits three people who have taken the plunge.

programme.title: Little Alien
programme.desc: Teenagers try to flee to Europe under life-threatening circumstances, hidden in trucks, where they become the hunted by the border authorities.

programme.title: Nation Estate
programme.desc: In, part one of this sci-fi triology, a vertical solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict has been found.

programme.title: China Reverse
programme.desc: Documentary about the first and second generation of Chinese migrants, stranded mainly in the country's Asian restaurants.

programme.title: Feldarbeit
programme.desc: FELDARBEIT tells of an encounter between a young woman and her father which takes place on his asparagus farm to the west of Berlin.

programme.title: Un coup d'oeil
programme.desc: Maryam and Frida are close friends living in a small Swedish town. They invite Monique, a mysterious couch surfer, to stay the night.

programme.title: Kleptomami
programme.desc: A film about the absurdities of being a mom today.

programme.title: Swimmers
programme.desc: The doc about the cult surrounding a Soviet physicist Boris Zolotov was awarded the ARTE documentary award.

programme.title: Lockbuster
programme.desc: When all his colleagues leave the office for exciting holidays, office clerk Joost locks himself in the storage room. The only way to escape is to unleash the hero within himself.

programme.title: Fair Traders
programme.desc: Three players in the free market economy accept responsibility for society and future generations: They do business sustainably.

programme.title: All About Rita
programme.desc: The love and life suffering of young people between Cologne and Berlin, with Woody Allenesque lightness.

programme.title: Ghetto
programme.desc: A touching documentary about the everyday life of Zurich's forgotten youth.

programme.title: Fraulein
programme.desc: An intimate look at three headstrong women who come from different parts of a country that no longer exists.

programme.title: Berlin Excelsior
programme.desc: The anonymous Berlin concrete building "Excelsior" is only a temporary stop for its residents, yet some have been living there for more than 50 years.

programme.title: Everything Always All the Time
programme.desc: What happens when your girlfriend suddenly has a penis?

programme.title: Lost in the Living
programme.desc: A young Irish musician immerses himself into Berlin nightlife after a concert and loses more than just his friends in the process.

programme.title: In die Welt - Into the World
programme.desc: This moving portrait of a maternity hospital in Vienna provides a fascinating insight into the drama, pain, and beauty of being born into this world.

programme.title: Of Neo-Nazis and Superheroes – How the Far Right is Changing a Small German Town
programme.desc: In the summer of 2017, 6,000 neo-Nazis from all over Europe gathered in Themar for the largest right-wing rock concert of the German post war era.

programme.title: We will survive
programme.desc: At the Julie-Roger-Haus in Frankfurt am Main, a care facility for seniors of all sexual orientations, "grandpa is finally allowed to be gay" (FAZ).

programme.title: Le Ciel, la Terre et L'Homme
programme.desc: The Aït Seghrouchen, a nomadic people from the windswept Moroccan desert, brave sandstorms, watch livestock and the cell phone towers.

programme.title: Blue Summer Symphony
programme.desc: The air smells like summer. A potpourri of suntan lotion lawn and lime blossom fries, of water polo melon and chlorine lemonade hovering in the air.

programme.title: Fall Pinguin
programme.desc: The penguins encounter Swiss alpine cows, swim in the river, walk leisurely through the city center... they are everywhere. An adventure begins.

programme.title: After the Future
programme.desc: Gay left-wing activist and disaster relief volunteer Ortwin Passon navigates between a military-like bourgeois world and wild sex parties.

programme.title: Monika
programme.desc: Sensitive coming-of-age drama about the visually impaired Monika (Rosalie Thomass), who is looking for her way to independence.

programme.title: Der Stoff, aus dem Träume sind
programme.desc: Housing is a human right. How can we guarantee housing in the increasingly difficult real estate markets in Europe's major cities?

programme.title: Semifinals 2
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation at Hero City Silicon Valley as 'Meet the Drapers' brings you the intense semifinals! Join the renowned Draper family Bill, Tim, Polly, and Adam as they assess 13 dynamic startups competing fiercely for just three coveted spots in the upcoming finals. With anticipation running high, witness the thrilling journey of these startups as they vie for recognition and a chance to make it to the grand finale.

programme.title: Could This Business Rival Kumon?
programme.desc: Its no secret that the pandemic hammered small businesses - especially those with brick and mortar locations. But this weeks guest, Angela, wasnt going to let her thriving math enrichment business close, even when her store had to. As a prime example of the power of the pivot, shes actually managed to more than double her customer base and take her Philadelphia local business Trapezium Math, national by moving it online...

programme.title: Eggs and Wine
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Napa, California to talk with Hardy Wallace, co-founder of Dirty and Rowdy Family Winery, an artisan wine maker that's breaking all the rules. Then they head to San Marino, California to meet up with Shaun and Gary Tuch, the founders of Professor Egghead, an interactive science and engineering program for kids.

programme.title: Room for Lunch
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Los Angeles, California to talk with Filip and Nadia Kristo, the creator of Roomescape Los Angeles, a live group based escape game. Then they head to White Lake Michigan to talk to Sherry French, the creator of SpBang, a company that manufactures reusable lunch products.

programme.title: These Founders Started Their Company with a $300K Investment
programme.desc: Features female founders from the travel, beauty, and fashion industries. Each pitch offers something new and intriguing: One startup founder claims a valuation upward of $20 million, another boasts $5 million in sales and another uses an off the cuff style that she believes provides a more genuine pitch.

programme.title: The CEOs of Hallow, & Decasonic
programme.desc: Introducing Alex Jones, CEO of Hallow, the #1 Christian prayer app, offering audio-guided meditation for spiritual growth. Also, meet Paul Hsu, CEO of Decasonic, a venture and digital assets fund, with experience at Zynga and as a founding member of NeoCarta.

programme.title: The CEOs of Orzinga, & Grubhub
programme.desc: Introducing Ozinga, a 5th-generation family-owned American company supplying bulk materials and concrete solutions. Also, meet Adam DeWitt, outgoing Grubhub CEO, with finance expertise and board roles at Ritchie Bros. and The Joffrey Ballet.

programme.title: Creative Minds, Autonomous Cruising, & 3D Surgery
programme.desc: Jessy & Jonny visit the campus of IDC Herzliya, one of Israels leading universities, and test out some cool new experimental research projects. We also take you to meet Cortex, one of the leaders behind autonomous self-driving car technology, and discover the innovators of the mind-blowing 3D Holoscope holographic surgical assistance machine.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: Don't Horse Around with the Chocolate

programme.desc: Rich Antoniello is the co-founder and CEO of Complex Media. Complex is the intersection between all things pop culture from hip hop to sneakers and dominates the male market of 18-24 with 55m monthly viewers. Through the companies latest annual conference, ComplexCon, they're now disrupting traditional retail by providing a fully immersive experience for event goers. They've been disrupting media for decades and caught the attention of Verizon and Hearst in 2016, who jointly acquired 50% of the company for reportedly well over $250m.

programme.title: Can a Product Aimed at Classrooms Turn a Profit? Part 2
programme.desc: How many times have you been told that will never work? Probably not as often as Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph. The veteran Silicon Valley entrepreneur, advisor, investor, speaker, and best-selling author has founded or co-founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored scores of entrepreneurs from first-time business owners to established CEOs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.title: Super Coffee: How to Scale Culture in a Family Business
programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. He dropped out of college to go full-time on his side-hustle and now, together with his two brothers runs the bottled beverage brand out of Austin, Texas. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

programme.title: Dinner and Apps
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Seattle, Washington to talk with chef Edouardo Jordan, creator of Salare, a farm to table restaurant with rave reviews. Then they head to Ann Arbor, Michigan to talk to Skye Durrant and Brandon Bertrang founders of LawnGuru, an online lawn service and mobile app.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.desc: On this week's episode of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, contestants present new ways to buy, sell and connect online -- and get around in the real world.

programme.title: The CEOs of Portillos, Stacked, & Lettuce
programme.desc: Join The CEO Series to meet Michael Osanloo, CEO of Portillos, Joel Birch CEO of Stacked, & Kevin Brown, CEO of Lettuce Entertain You. Discover their inspiring stories and industry insights.

programme.title: Digital Music, Robots, Cyber Crime, & Art
programme.desc: Jonny Caplan shows why Israel is often referred to as The Silicon Valley of the Middle East or The Start-up Nation and why it's one of the leading places to build a start-up. Dont miss the AI robots at Tel Aviv University, and other exciting tech.

programme.title: Work Dating, Coded Lego, & Robot Companions
programme.desc: Our journey continues to find the best innovators and emerging entrepreneurs worldwide. Jonny & Jessy travel across Israel to find out what it took Danny from Algobrix to make supercharged coded Lego games, and Ron and the team, to create their revolutionary employment matching app. We also meet ElliQ, the AI Robot companion designed to engage and guard the elderly.

programme.title: India
programme.desc: This week, the Drapers explore India with guests Nikhil Kamath and Nupur Hemant. Pitches include NextGeneration's orthopedic tech, Unstop's career platform, NeuroPixel's AI in fashion, and Karya's mobile solutions for rural India. Which startup will reach the semi-finals? Tune in!

programme.title: Data Driven by Design
programme.desc: Katie, co-owner of Studio 882, an interior design and furniture showroom out of Glen Mills, PA. Katie believes she has found the secret sauce that will grow the business to the next level and enable her to expand around the US. Shes reapplying airport software, including air traffic control monitoring and facial recognition, to enhance the customer experience and mine valuable information about why one sofa sits and one sofa fits. It's a potential treasure trove of information if her team would put it to use.

programme.title: How Burger King Is Making a Comeback
programme.desc: Burger King president Tom Curtis discusses how listening directly to customers helped reshape the brand and bring people back, in a conversation hosted by Jason Feifer.

programme.title: Level Up On IG Reels W/ Afnan Idris
programme.desc: If you understand your audience, you can monetize your IG Reels. Afnan Idris talks about Instagram Reels and how to grab attention and monetize them. Many influencers are gaining high viewership rates through IG Reels, and its critical that you understand your audience. People are waiting to hear your story, so grab attention and be relatable.

programme.title: Learn How To Handle Anxiety & Face Your Fear Of The Future
programme.desc: Learning how to handle anxiety about the future is an essential step toward achieving your goals. When faced with uncertainty, we tend to fear the future. But it doesnt have to be this way. In this episode, we introduce a few strategies to stop letting fear get in your way. Learn effective methods for how to handle anxiety by interrupting your thoughts, turning your attention toward those thoughts, and questioning whether your fear of the future is genuinely valid.

programme.title: The Freelance Skills & Mindset You NEED To Succeed, or Freelancing For Beginners
programme.desc: With more and more of the workforce becoming freelance, we've got lots of people getting into this fantastic way of living, but we need to learn how to get started. Freelancing takes a set of skills and a mindset that many beginners don't quite understand fully, so it's essential to show you all the ropes so you can get started and take your business to the next level.

programme.title: Complex Used Hip Hop & Sneakers to Create 55M+ Viewers and Sell for Over $250M
programme.desc: Rich Antoniello is the co-founder and CEO of Complex Media. Complex is the intersection between all things pop culture from hip hop to sneakers and dominates the male market of 18-24 with 55m monthly viewers. Through the companies latest annual conference, ComplexCon, they're now disrupting traditional retail by providing a fully immersive experience for event goers. They've been disrupting media for decades and caught the attention of Verizon and Hearst in 2016, who jointly acquired 50% of the company for reportedly well over $250m.

programme.title: A New Spin On Music & Business
programme.desc: MICK used music to propel his career. He has spun private events for some of the worlds most prominent celebrities, brands, tech companies and philanthropic organizations including Beyonce, Bravo, Cadillac, Entertainment Weekly, Fast Company, Gary Vaynerchuk, Hillary Clinton, HBO, Instagram, Interview Magazine, Jay Z, Jimmy Kimmel, LeBron James, Michelle Obama, and the list goes on. Through his influence he has become the center of everything relevant, tech and culture, and has used his brand to create massive opportunity.

programme.title: Flying Cars, Holographic Food, & Autonomous Firefighters
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Rafi Yoeli, who spent the last 30 years designing Flying Cars, Taxis & Rescue Vehicles. Also, see Holographic food menus, ordering, and drones that fly into burning buildings to warn the Fire Fighters before they venture in and risk their lives.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. We also visit an aeronautics technology fund, enhancing our air travel, and watch Jonnys connected car get hacked and taken over by a trained cybersecurity expert!

programme.title: Want a Job, a Baby or Some New Friends?
programme.desc: From new social networking apps to fertility trackers and a company using AI to recruit for businesses, episode three is packed with ideas to improve people's lives. Still, not all entrepreneurs behind these solutions will get to step through the elevator doors.

programme.title: The Fire Extinguisher and the Screwdriver of the 21st Century
programme.desc: This episode features new takes on old products and industries, from a handheld device that puts out fires to a carpal-tunnel-defying tool to a multi-purpose baseball cap. Will some short flubs during the pitch keep a modern fire extinguisher from getting into the boardroom?

programme.title: Africa
programme.desc: This week's episode features the Draper familyTim and Pollyjoined by Naveen Jain, Founder and CEO of Viome Life Sciences, and Cardinal Peter Turkson from the Catholic Church. Discover BuuPass for affordable travel bookings. Explore FlexClub for hassle-free bike, car, and truck subscriptions. Dive into Daba's insights, unlocking African investment potential. Judges decide the fate in this gripping African episode. Who stays, who goes?

programme.title: Saudi Arabia
programme.desc: Tim Draper seeks investments with guest judges Sultan Fahd bin Salman Al Saud and Amal Dokhan. At Leap in Saudi Arabia, startups like MetaWorldX (digital twin company), Diagnio (affordable hormonal health tests), IMAN (Halal Investment), TakaDAO (blockchain insurance), and Provenmed (urinary incontinence devices) pitch. Discover the chosen Saudi Arabian company for the semi-finals as judges unveil their decision.

programme.title: Music Mogul DJ Khaled Drops Business & Life Keys
programme.desc: DJ Khaled is a world renowned record producer, DJ, record label executive and entrepreneur. The larger-than-life music producer and DJ is known for working with A-list talent such as Jay-Z, Beyonc, Lil Wayne and Nicki Minaj and producing platinum hits. On this exclusive episode, Khaled shares his keys to social media, talks about performing at the Grammys with Rhianna, and shares about his friendship with JayZ.

programme.title: Hip Hop Legend Damon Dash Explains How His Street Mentality Catapulted Him to the Top
programme.desc: Damon Dash not only solidified himself as a music mogul but grew Rocawear into a top streetwear company that sold for a reported $204 million. Damon later opened DD172, an art gallery and creative collective in New York City, in addition to founding Creative Control -- a digital media platform that explored the intersection of music, art and culture. His portfolio of ventures also includes a spirits company, another clothing company and Dame Dash Studios. And, he's releasing a new film called Honor Up which was executive produced by Kanye and scheduled for release this year.

programme.title: How To Know If Your Business Idea Is A Winner
programme.desc: On this weeks full episode of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, investors hear their final round of pitches from entrepreneurs. When big money meets big ideas, everyone benefits. This weeks investors are Marc Randolph, co-founder and first CEO of Netflix; Kim Perell, CEO of 100.co and serial entrepreneur; and Rogers Healy, owner and CEO of Morrison Seger Venture Capital Partners.

programme.title: Creative Minds, Autonomous Cruising, & 3D Surgery
programme.desc: Jessy & Jonny visit the campus of IDC Herzliya, one of Israels leading universities, and test out some cool new experimental research projects. We also take you to meet Cortex, one of the leaders behind autonomous self-driving car technology, and discover the innovators of the mind-blowing 3D Holoscope holographic surgical assistance machine.

programme.title: AR Snowboarding, Surfing Freedom, & Robotic Soccer
programme.desc: RideOn conceptualized their Augmented Reality Snowboarding product while flying as fighter pilots in the army, and using similar technology. Meet CEO and Founder Alon Getz, and discover how some governments block internet access, and the makers of tools to help them access digital freedom.

programme.title: Italy
programme.desc: Get ready for another thrilling episode of 'Meet the Drapers' as the show goes global! This time, venture capitalist Tim Draper embarks on a quest to uncover the world's next billion-dollar idea, and they've chosen the picturesque backdrop of Italy! Experience the excitement as the Draper family, joined by notable guests Naveen Jain and Cardinal Peter Turkson, evaluates groundbreaking Italian startups such as Pagapresto, Kajaa, Real House, and Ipermatch. Be a part of the gripping moments as the judges meticulously select the semi-finalists, while the audience actively participates in determining the esteemed finalists in this exhilarating entrepreneurial odyssey!

programme.title: Can a Product Aimed at Classrooms Turn a Profit? Part 2
programme.desc: How many times have you been told that will never work? Probably not as often as Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph. The veteran Silicon Valley entrepreneur, advisor, investor, speaker, and best-selling author has founded or co-founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored scores of entrepreneurs from first-time business owners to established CEOs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.title: Did This Entrepreneur Just Abort His Own Mission?
programme.desc: This episodes entrepreneurs present cigars, skincare products, cookie dough, and more. Meanwhile, this weeks investors, find themselves conflicted about everything from health benefits to valuations.

programme.title: Casual Geographic’s Guide to Making Content People Actually Watch
programme.desc: Mamadou Ndiaye of Casual Geographic shares advice on creating videos, building an audience and turning your interests into a successful career.

programme.title: Why Most Founders Can't Grow Past 25 Employees
programme.desc: Weebly co-founder David Rusenko reflects on scaling the company, confronting his own leadership challenges and the dinner with Richard Branson that changed his approach.

programme.title: Edible Selfies, Extreme Beer Pong and More!
programme.desc: On our fast-paced pitch show, entrepreneurs seek investment from judges. The panel gets pitched a wide variety of items -- everything from fitness gear to edible selfies to an organic toilet bowl cleaner.

programme.title: Profitability Tips With Lamar Tyler
programme.desc: Lamar Tyler gives incredibly valuable tips on how to increase profit in business. These are tips that can genuinely change your business for the better. Focus on the customers that you already have. How can you increase the average amount they spend, and increase their customer lifetime value? Too many entrepreneurs go after new customers rather than retaining old ones.

programme.title: Has Anybody Not Seen That Product?
programme.desc: Hopeful contestants may think their ideas are fresh and exciting, but more than half will fall short of the investors standards. From 21st-century photo booths to a line of lingerie, some judges will invest, but others will leave them puzzled or unconvinced.

programme.desc: Every start-up needs some help; incubators are a great way to get the resources you need, plus financial support. We visited TechCode, a Chinese incubator, and learned about a 30-year journey to ensure that Robots and Humans will live together in harmony.

programme.desc: In this episode, the Drapers and guest judges Love Yadav (General Partner at Mountain Lion Ventures) and Yureni Noshika (Actor, Model & TV Personality) assess four Sri Lankan startups: Nootz Coconut for tropical smoothies, SpectrifyAI for AI/ML tea and spice analysis, Hyperglade for Web2 to Web3 transition, and RHODA for sustainable urban mobility. Find out which startup moves to the semi-finals!

programme.title: Did Marc Just Get Career Envy?
programme.desc: James is an adventurer in both life and business. But when your career is breaking world records how do you turn that into a sustainable business? He thinks he found his answer when he created his wilderness team building program My Adventure Group and hes getting rave reviews. The trouble is, hes just not getting enough customers.

programme.title: Why Most Founders Can't Grow Past 25 Employees
programme.desc: Weebly co-founder David Rusenko reflects on scaling the company, confronting his own leadership challenges and the dinner with Richard Branson that changed his approach.

programme.title: Cheesy Effects
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Bandon, Oregon to talk with Greg Drobot and Daniel Graham, the co-founders of Facerock Creamery, an artisan cheese factory and retail store. Then they head to Poway, California to talk with Brea Joseph, the owner of KBZ FX, a special FX make-up studio.

programme.title: What Is Mindfulness? Start Living In The Present Moment And Do More With A Mindful Hustle
programme.desc: Being mindful and living in the present moment will allow you to keep up with the daily hustle without becoming too overwhelmed. Mindful hustle is the idea that you can be productive while pausing your mind throughout the day to stay present. By cultivating mindfulness throughout your day, you can avoid much of the stress that builds over the day.

programme.title: Setting Your Goals - Here's How To Achieve The Goals You Set
programme.desc: So many of us set big (or small) goals in life, but the reality is that so few of us hit those goals we set. If you want to achieve and surpass those goals, you need a reliable process to get you there. In this video, I will teach you exactly how to set goals in a way that pushes you toward them.

programme.title: Kym Gold Explains How She Started and Sold True Religion for $835M
programme.desc: Kym Gold is the co-creator of True Religion Brand Jeans; author of the business book Gold Standard: How to Rock the World and Run an Empire; and producer for projects with a social conscience, including the documentary SLAG: Served Like a Girl. Kyms unwavering drive has helped her achieve success as a designer and entrepreneur. She shares tips about life, business and selling her company for $800m+.

programme.title: Redefining Modern Art In The Graffiti Generation
programme.desc: Timmy Sneaks is a modern creative and graffiti artist from Boston. His unique style and brand has garnered interest from the highest level brand and influencers like Kevin Hart, Scott Disick and Robinson Cano. In this episode of Action & Ambition with Andrew Medal, Timmy discusses his beginnings and how he turned his passion for art into a thriving business, keys to luxury branding, and the vision for his empire.

programme.title: Drone Deliveries, Remote TV Scanners, & Age Monitoring
programme.desc: Meet Flytrex & their intelligent drone delivery system for any business. Order your drone package, and be delivered by drone in no time. JC visits WeWork Tel Aviv to find an exciting start-up that creates a TV scanner app to hear any audio on your phone from a TV in an airport, or train station. We also talk to Ruth about her impactful venture to help to monitor and protect us from old age.

programme.title: Futuristic Zappers, Robot Washers, & Brain Gaming
programme.desc: The Season Finale discovers five innovators who are making headway and, ranging from futuristic scanners that can detect the quality & makeup of fruit, meat, pills & other substances, to Autonomous Robot Window Washers that can scale tall buildings & Mind Controlled Games to assist with ADHD. Israel is a hotbed for innovation & houses more start-ups per capita than anywhere else.

programme.title: People Suck at Judging Other People
programme.desc: This episode is all about technology. From custom handbags to on-demand personal trainers, four creative entrepreneurs enter the elevator with high-tech ideas for everyday goods and services.

programme.title: Can a Saliva Test Tell You Whether He's the One?
programme.desc: Entrepreneurs pitch their solutions to various problems, from finding love to staying hydrated in bed. Plus, an all-in-one picture-hanging tool tries to level up the boardroom.

programme.title: Sri Sri University
programme.desc: Tim Draper, along with humanitarian leader Sri Sri Ravi Shankar and Madan Padaki, evaluates diverse Indian startups, including Ukhi (textiles & bio-plastics from Hemp), Stellar Grid (Solar Rooftop Market solutions), BONV. (carbon-free smart aerial mobility), E-panipurii kartz (touchless operation for Panipuri vendors), and Wow Mom (healthy fast food). The suspense builds as the judges decide who advances to the semi-finals and who goes home.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: In this episode, Tim Draper and guest judges Michael Amar, Samantha Bohbot, and Lars Seier Christensen assess innovative startups like Bubblemaps (blockchain data), Staex (Web3 connectivity for machines), Sneakmart (streetwear community app), Secret Keylabs (advanced Bitcoin wallet), and Playmakers (user-generated content platform for games). Tension builds as judges unveil which Paris startup advances to the semi-finals!

programme.title: From Psychedelics to a $28m+ Business Empire to New York Times Best Seller
programme.desc: Aubrey Marcus is the founder and CEO of Onnit, a lifestyle brand based on a holistic health philosophy he calls Total Human Optimization. Since its founding, Onnit has become an Inc. 500 company and industry leader with over 250 products ranging from peak performance supplements to foods, fitness equipment, and apparel. Inspired by his lifelong experience as a multisport athlete as well as his background in ancient philosophy his goal was to create a company that empowered customers to achieve their fullest human potential. With the launch of the firms flagship supplement Alpha BRAIN in 2011, Onnit was born.

programme.title: From State Pen to Y Combinator Graduate to Mega-Million Dollar Business
programme.desc: Frederick is the CEO and founder of Pigeonly, a low-cost communication and financial services platform that makes it easy for people to support an incarcerated loved one. He came up with the idea after serving time in the Federal Penitentiary for distributing 3,000 kg of weed. Hutson leads a growing team of over 20 people from their Las Vegas headquarters and has raised over $5MM in funding from investors.

programme.title: How To Sustain High Performance - Sami Inkinen of Virta Health
programme.desc: Sami Inkinen shares how a health scare changed his approach to entrepreneurship and led him to build Virta Health around the idea of sustainable high performance.

programme.title: Alpaca the Candles
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to White City, Oregon to talk with Richard and Renata Gyuro, the founder of Alpaca's at Lone Ranch, an Alpaca farm and retail store. Then they head over to Garden Grove, California to meet up with Diosdado Velasquez, the founder of Natures Kindle, handcrafted soy candles.

Get ready for LuminX's revolutionary Cellular Tracking, Streamteck's cutting-edge medical AIoT service, Blocktag's seamless bridge between physical and digital worlds, and Bened Biomed's groundbreaking pharmaceutical marvels with novel probiotics for the nervous system. programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

The veteran Silicon Valley entrepreneur has founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored entrepreneurs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan.

programme.desc: Army vet Cooper is the founder of SoBet, a new peer-to-peer sports betting and social media platform that targets the elusive Gen-Z consumer. But its a pitch that Marc has heard a thousand times before and most of those pitches failed to make it. Can this West Point grad prove both to Marc - and to the market - that his mix of reducing the juice and onboarding influencers is enough to get his platform off the ground?

programme.title: Can a Saliva Test Tell You Whether He's the One?

This next level of athletic achievement was the obvious choice for him as he comes from a pedigree of football elites. Boss training programs have grown into the brand, Total Player LLC, an umbrella company he created to introduce luxury health and fitness.

Five Four/MenloClub is the leading mens fashion membership e-commerce platform with a portfolio of five brands that include: New Republic by Mark McNairy, Grand AC and Oshenta. He is also a seasoned investor and partner at Queenbridge Venture Partners and partner in popular Las Vegas shoe store, 12 AM RUN. He is a co-host with Chris Drama Pfaff in a weekly lifestyle podcast Group Chat, in addition to his business ventures.

With anticipation running high, witness the thrilling journey of these startups as they vie for recognition and a chance to make it to the grand finale.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.title: Dr. Sebi's Daughter Talks National Holiday, Documentary, and Wellness
programme.desc: Kellie Bowman, daughter of the late Dr. Sebi, owner of Sebi’s Daughters LLC, and celebrity nurse, is a passionate advocate for holistic health practices that can truly transform lives. With a profound understanding of the mind-body connection passed down from her father, Kellie offers a unique blend of insights that can empower informed choices for holistic well-being. She's also working on a national holiday to honor her late father's pioneer work in the health and wellness sector and speaks on the Dr. Sebi documentary Nick Cannon is working on.

programme.title: Jay Jordan of Reform Alliance Explains Importance of Probation Reform
programme.desc: Jay Jordan, Reform Alliance’s new VP of Community Engagement, is shedding light on the nonprofit’s new C-Suite additions and the critical role they’ll play in driving its mission forward. He breaks down why Reform’s focus on probation and parole reform is so essential to criminal justice reform—and how having major celebrity support helps bring both attention and bipartisan momentum to the cause.

programme.title: Yvette Nicole Brown & Kym Whitley Sound Off On Trump & Defend Mayor Bass
programme.desc: Actresses Yvette Nicole Brown and Kym Whitley aren't biting their tongues when it comes to defending Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass from criticism over her response to the SoCal wildfires, blasting the Black celebs who performed at Trump's inauguration, and giving their two senses on what the next four years hold. The "Act Your Age" stars sit down with BLACK ENTERPRISE to share their spirited take on the current state of the country.

programme.title: Gabrielle Union Shares Kaavia's Inspiration In New PROUDLY Clothing Launch
programme.desc: Actress and entrepreneur Gabrielle Union is leading the expansion of her PROUDLY baby care line into babywear. In a conversation with Jeroslyn JoVonn on The Culture Shift, Union shares how her daughter Kaavia inspired the designs and opens up about how she and husband Dwyane Wade collaborate on family and business decisions.

programme.title: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" Director Explains Use of Satire
programme.desc: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" director and cast sits down with BLACK ENTERPRISE "The Culture Shift" to share how the satirical comedy tackles the “magical negro” trope popularized in American cinema and television throughout the 20th Century. Director Kobi Libii, lead actor Justice Smith, and supporting actress Nicole Byer explain the film's plot and it aims to inspire Black viewers to see the value in themselves.

programme.title: Lil Jon Manifests Abundance On New Guided Meditation Album
programme.desc: After 20 years of helping us turn up, Grammy award-winning rapper/producer Lil Jon is assisting us with turning down and tuning in to ourselves with his second guided meditation album "Manifest Abundance." The album coincides with his partnership with the wellness supplement brand Natural Vitality during Mental Health Awareness Month. Lil Jon sits down with Black Enterprise to share how he found the balance between partying for work and practicing mindfulness during his downtime. He also shares the perfect mantra to use throughout the day.

programme.title: Permission to Put Yourself First
programme.desc: The most accomplished women will tell you there’s no shame in asking for what you want. We’re sitting down with beloved actress and entrepreneur Tia Mowry to explore how to find success and happiness by making yourself priority No. 1. Remarks: Courtney Johnson, Regional Vice President, National Sales & Account Management; Co-Chair, Black Leadership Forum, Prudential Speaker: Tia Mowry, Founder & Owner, 4U by Tia Moderator: Tashara Parker, Emmy award-winning journalist; Social Justice Advocate

programme.title: Network Your Way to Success
programme.desc: Hate small talk? Not a people person? Our networking coach will help you overcome your discomfort to become a master networker—even if you’re an introvert. Facilitator: Jevonya Allen, Creator & Chief Visionary Officer, Twisted Networking

programme.title: Progress, Not Perfection Hosted by Eli Lilly & Company
programme.desc: It’s time to let go, once and for all, of the idea that we have to be perfect and instead learn to get out of our comfort zones, cultivate risk, and embrace failure. Speakers: Kelly Copes-Anderson, Global Head of Diversity Equity & Inclusion, Lilly Dr. Yasmene Mumby, Founder & Principal, The Ringgold Dr. Lauren Young, Chief Diversity and Inclusion Officer, Travelers Moderator: Jacqueline M. Baker, Principal Consultant & Founder, Scarlet

programme.title: Issa Rae WPS 2023
programme.desc: We’re sitting down with a Luminary honoree to explore this year’s theme—Our Time, Our Way, Our Power—and to reveal how she’s succeeding on her own terms. Speaker: Issa Rae, Producer; Writer, Director Moderator: Alisa Gumbs, Deputy Chief Content Officer, BLACK ENTERPRISE

programme.title: Self-Reliance - How It Can Help You Get Farther Ahead
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Rundown with Ramon," media consultant Maha Abouelenein discusses her new book, "Seven Rules of Self-Reliance." In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Abouelenein shares insights from her career working with tech giants and high-profile individuals, offering practical advice for personal and professional growth. She emphasizes the importance of creating value, managing one's reputation, and adopting a long-term mindset. Abouelenein also shares personal experiences that shaped her approach to life and work, providing listeners with actionable strategies for success in today's fast-paced world.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Can Everyone Be a Millionaire? With This Mindset, Yes!
programme.desc: Money has a significant impact on our lives, and our relationship with it can shape our financial journey — for better or for worse. In an interview with Toyin Crandell, founder of Toyin Crandell Coaching, Ramon Ray unpacks her journey from financial apathy to business success, providing inspiration and insights for anyone looking to redefine their relationship with money and success. Crandell’s story is a testament to the power of a money mindset shift — one that led her from feeling indifference toward money to setting an ambitious financial goal and achieving it in just three years.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Don't Try to Hide Personal from Business on Social Media
programme.desc: Many business owners ask if they can post personal and business on social media. YES, it's good to share your personal life, to some degree on your business oriented social media. However, if you're trying to have something "hidden" then don't. Share things you don't want anyone to see on restricted platforms like What's App. Twitter(X) changed it's blocked user settings, to allow people to see your posts, even though you've blocked them. Other things covered on The Rundown with Ramon include: -Evaluating business idea viability -Seth Godin's writing advice on brevity -LinkedIn's AI job recruitment tools -Oura Smart Ring review -Health considerations for entrepreneurs over 40 -Hard vs. soft luggage debate -Making meaningful professional connections -Twitter/X's blocking feature update -Building startups while maintaining mental health

programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

One of the things that makes that journey a bit less rocky is leaning on fellow entrepreneurs like Brian Hess, who recently shared his top tips for business owners with Ramon Ray. As the founder of the Pavement Group and Top Contractor School, Brian has a wealth of knowledge to offer. In this podcast episode, Brian shares his journey, business principles, and advice for entrepreneurs.

programme.title: Supporting the Creator Economy

programme.title: Jackie Aina on Building Her Brand, Beauty Deals, and Boss Moves

programme.title: Brian Tyree Henry Talks His EP Debut In "Dope Thief" w/ Wagner Moura
programme.desc: Brian Tyree Henry is no stranger to captivating audiences on screen, but this time, he’s taking on a dual role—both starring in and executive producing his latest project, *Dope Thief* on Apple TV+. A medida que el monstruo se vuelve más errático e impredecible, Jeremy descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de su hija y el destino que le ha deparado una fuente improbable. ¿Podrá Jeremy acabar finalmente con la pesadilla del monstruo navideño que ha aterrorizado a este pueblo durante años?

programme.title: Isla de las Muñecas

programme.title: Ana

Cree haber encontrado su próximo tema cuando se encuentra con Alfred, un muñeco del tamaño de un niño que puede cobrar vida. Pero surgen consecuencias mortales cuando Brendan se da cuenta de que Alfred tiene intención de matar.

Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.desc: Todd Bonura, Tom Stevenson, and KJ share gator hunting close calls, a grizzly bear encounter at dark, and why swamp hunting at night is a different kind of scary on Gun Talk Hunt.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Lightning, Wolves & Drug Busts in the Dark -S6E5
programme.desc: KJ, game warden Jeremy King, and land agent Thomas Allen share their scariest hunting moments — lightning strikes, a midnight drug bust, and wolves in northern Minnesota.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Backyard Cookout Intruder - S3E7
programme.desc: TJ defends friends and family at a cookout from a knife-wielding robber. Will a hostage deter him from using deadly force?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Assault at the Drug Clinic - S3E8
programme.desc: Christine, a nurse, is leaving work when an armed intruder demands drugs. Does she have the wherewithal to draw from her purse to intervene when the intruder attacks?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Parking Lot Stabbing - S3E9
programme.desc: Jessica witnesses a stabbing in parking lot and intervenes to help the victim. Will she use verbal commands and avoid closing gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gun Fight at the Party - S3E10
programme.desc: Colin is at a party when a guest gets unruly with some female guests. Will he survive the encounter, and how will he deal with multiple assailants?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Bar Fight Escalation - S3E11
programme.desc: Gary witnesses an argument escalating in bar. Does he draw too soon trying to game the game? Will he perform when a distraction causes him to react more slowly?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Pool Table Gunfight - S3E12
programme.desc: Matte witnesses an argument escalating around a pool table at the bar. What is available for cover when the fight threatens to turn deadly? Will he close the gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - ATM Armed Robbery - S3E13
programme.desc: Matt intervenes in ATM robbery. Will his experience lead him to create distance, verbal commands and avoid closing gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Workplace Shooting - S3E14
programme.desc: Doug attends workplace meeting when an armed intruder bursts in and starts shooting. Does he use cover, verbal commands and know how to prioritize threats?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Home Burglary Safe Access - S4E1
programme.desc: Mike defends his home from an intruder. He uses a laser, cover, and family coordination. Lessons: quick safe drills, clear commands, doorway advantage.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Classroom Active Shooter Response - S4E2
programme.desc: David faces an active shooter bursting into the classroom. He learns to announce his good guy status, move people to safety, use doorway cover, and pie corners.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gas Station Armed Confrontation - S4E3
programme.desc: Tim witnesses an agitated customer escalating at gas station, he draws when a gun appears. He learns to de-escalate early, contact shots, and how to articulate to 911.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Property Inspection Robbery - S4E4
programme.desc: Lyle inspects a vacant house with realtor when armed robbers attack. He learns one-handed gun manipulation, punch-style one-handed shooting and chambering a round for readiness.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Store Domestic Dispute Shooting - S4E5
programme.desc: Nathan, an EMT, witnesses an agitated man escalate a domestic dispute in a store, attacking with bat. He learns to create distance early, verbal commands and to intervene on deadly force.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Apartment Intruder Response - S4E6
programme.desc: Roseanne defends her apartment from an intruder after being alerted by an open door. She learns to stage guns, instinctive laser aim and use clear commands.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gas Station Domestic Escalation - S4E7
programme.desc: Raven defends a gas station from a bat-wielding attacker in a domestic dispute. She learns to get distance, verbal commands and when to intervene.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Auto Shop Armed Robbery - S5E1
programme.desc: Dispute at an auto shop escalates into armed threats. Ben defends his friend and uses cover to close the distance. Preparation beats reaction.

programme.title: First Person Defender - ATM Double Armed Robbery - S5E2
programme.desc: Brian defends against two armed ATM robbers. He learns to counter flank, hold cover, and articulate perceived danger.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Driveway Car Break-In Defense - S5E3
programme.desc: Carson defends against a driveway car break-in. He learns evasion, vehicle cover, malfunction drills, and why distance beats draw.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Deer Stand Standoff - S5E4
programme.desc: Doug faces trespasser in deer stand. Will he walk away, report theft or fight over a rifle. Action beats reaction; discretion saves lives.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Home Invasion Baseball Bat Threat - S5E5
programme.desc: Graham defends against a bat-wielding intruder in his home. Fast draws, evasion, deflection, and why not to chase are covered. Decisiveness is key in close quarters.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Camping Armed Trespasser - S5E6
programme.desc: Ian defends his girlfriend and camp from demanding intruders. His quick draw on furtive movement, distance, and distractions are key.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Office Shooting Response - S5E7
programme.desc: Joey hears chaos and shooting from a back room at work. Will he confront an armed suspect and neutralize the threat? He learns gun security and to prioritize the wounded.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Backyard Fishing Hook Ambush - S5E8
programme.desc: Jon aids "injured" fisherman on his backyard deck. The ruse leads to an armed robbery with his friend as a hostage. Training includes deflection and garment clearing under pressure.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Music Store Armed Robbery - S5E9

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 3 - Grit, Guts, and Game-Changers
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation with The Big Reveal! Join Sheriff Mark Lamb and MMA legend Ken Shamrock as they explore groundbreaking American companies revolutionizing their industries. From elite camo designed through deer vision science to lightweight titanium firearm suppressors and EMF-neutralizing tech for peak performance—each story uncovers passion, ingenuity, and grit. Discover what’s shaping America’s entrepreneurial spirit. It’s not just business. It’s The Big Reveal.

programme.title: Special Edition - Aires Tech: The Invisible Shield
programme.desc: Sheriff Mark Lamb (Surviving Mann) and UFC Hall of Famer Ken Shamrock (Surviving Mann) uncover a breakthrough changing how we live in a world full of invisible forces. Join them as Aires Tech reveals the science behind a revolutionary technology built to protect the human body from electromagnetic stress—empowering performance in a wired world.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 5 - Special Edition - Aires Tech: The Frequency of Wellness
programme.desc: From the ocean to the lab, The Big Reveal dives deeper into the hidden impact of electromagnetic pollution. Discover how Aires Tech is helping people, animals, and even bees thrive—unlocking the secrets to balance, vitality, and true wellness in our connected age.

programme.title: Special Edition - Air Tractor: Built for the Sky
programme.desc: Take flight with The Big Reveal as Don Mann (Surviving Mann), Sheriff Mark Lamb (Surviving Mann), and Laura Zaspel (Farm Hero) visit Air Tractor—America’s iconic maker of crop dusters, firefighting, and military aircraft. Witness the power, precision, and pride behind the company proving that American craftsmanship still soars.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 7 - Special Edition - Air Tractor: Inside The Flying Office
programme.desc: Laura Zaspel (Farm Hero) takes you inside the cockpit for a high-flying look at the future of farming. From cutting-edge aerial applications to next-gen science and sustainability, Air Tractor’s technology is redefining how we grow from the ground up.

programme.title: Tools That Change the Outcome
programme.desc: This episode of The Big Reveal showcases high-performance tools and innovations built for critical moments—from Jersey Tactical’s life-saving breaching device and Green Light’s lightning-fast handgun sights to Henry Repeating Arms’ modern lever-action rifle and Truefin’s customizable scuba fins, each designed to deliver precision, reliability, and results when it matters most.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 9 - Unlocking Better Brain Health
programme.desc: Lesley Visser joins nutritionist Mike Roussell and NFL Hall of Famer Mike Singletary to explore Neutein, cognitive-health research and why brain wellness has become personal for many users.
